newsitem.title: UK: Murco withdraws from UK petroleum merger.
newsitem.headline: Murco withdraws from UK petroleum merger.

text.p: Elf UK and Gulf Oil are to forge ahead with a merger of their British refinery and petroleum marketing operations despite withdrawal from the venture of Murco Petroleum.
U.S. Murphy Corp on Thursday said it's UK subsidiary Murco had decided to exit the proposed merger in favour of going it alone in the highly competitive British petroleum retail sector.

"Our analysis of the proposed transaction indicated the advantages of scale of the newly merged company would not significantly improve Murphy's existing, cost-effective and efficient downstream system," said Murphy chief executive Claiborne Deming.
Britain's refining industry, like most of Europe, has suffered in recent years from a surplus capacity for gasoline production.
A price war among gasoline retailers, initiated at the start of last year by Esso UK in response to the rapid growth of supermarkets as gasoline retailers, has hit profit margins hard.
Elf Oil UK, a subsidiary of French Elf Aquitaine, and U.S. Chevron Corp's Gulf Oil said their merger remained on track for the launch of a new retail brand name by the middle of the year.
"The original plan was a combination of Elf and Gulf. Murco's withdrawal simply restores that concept," said Christian Cleret, Managing Director of Elf Oil UK.

The three companies signed a memorandum of understanding in November to consolidate their refining interests in Milford Haven in south Wales, by ceasing crude processing at the 115,000 barrels per day (bpd) Gulf refinery in Pembroke.
In November Elf said the merger plans would make a saving of 50 million sterling a year.
Murco would have taken 17.50 percent in the joint venture which is now expected to be shared equally between Elf and Gulf.
Even without Murco the new venture will account for some 7.5 percent of the UK petroleum market covering 960 sites becoming Britain's fourth largest behind Esso, Shell and BP.
Murco will retain its 30 percent share in the Elf/Gulf Milford Haven refinery in south Wales.
